concept_tasks.prompt: Redraw this exact creature from the reference images as a boss variant called the River Captain, keeping its identity: the same cute stylised semi-aquatic otter with chocolate-brown fur, cream muzzle, throat and chest, big bright blue eyes, small round ears, pale whiskers, clawed paws, and one broad, flat, dark scaled paddle tail. Same art style as the references: stylised creature-collector game (Palworld / Animo class), soft hand-painted fur, friendly and clever face. Changes: a river-captain harness crossing the chest with a sash in deep TEAL fabric and BRASS fittings, one small round brass buckle badge on the chest, a few water-worn tan rope wraps around both forearms, a slightly broader chest and a more upright, confident four-legged stance with head held high. Neutral standing pose for 3D modelling: all four legs straight and clearly separated from the body and each other, tail fully extended behind and fully visible, mouth closed. Colours only brown, cream, teal, brass and tan rope; absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon. No hat, no weapon, no props, no pedestal, no text, plain background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow.
